name: Hamilton County, Ohio (United States)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the county seal: a large dark red letter H with a crown and star on black, in a ring of stars within a scalloped orange border.
history: Hamilton County is located in the southwestern corner of Ohio. The flag was adopted on 14 June 2002 (according to Flags of the World, which also records that a new county logo adopted in September 2024 is now used on the flag).

features.role: county seal, a large letter H with a crown and star in a ring of stars, in a scalloped orange border
